style: Create original high-fantasy game art with chunky hand-inked dark contours, flat gouache-like color masses and restrained dry-brush texture, matching a painted dragon-and-kingdom deckbuilder; heroic with a light touch of humor. CARD art shows the power of an original half-dragon warrior through her parts and effects: copper-red dragon-scale gauntlets ending in four curved black-iron claws with glowing ember-orange cracks, a crimson spade-tipped dragon tail, translucent ember-fire wings and copper-red scales; plus the golem enemies, enchanted forest ruins, volcanic basalt and dragon fire. When the warrior appears, show only her gauntlets, claws, tail or wings, or a small silhouette from behind; never draw her face. Palette: blackened iron #2A2426, copper-red #B5532E, crimson #8E1B23, ivory #EFE2C4, amber #F2A93B, ember #FF8A2A, mossy greens, weathered stone and teal rune light. Bold readable silhouettes, two-step cel shading and selective warm highlights; reserve soft emission for fire, runes and VFX. Do not imitate any existing game, champion, franchise character, emblem or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, emblems, watermarks or typographic symbols, and respect each asset's stated background and framing requirements.
